delivery: Integrate the tested LangGraph workflow into Spring and React; build a manifest-bound IIS/Linux/WSL transfer distribution; organize active integration code and repository navigation; commit and push the reviewed source. This private pilot does not enable paid anonymous AI or deploy the remote machine.

modes.private_only: Any mode other than OFF requires PRIVATE access mode. ANONYMOUS denies AI routes even with a launch bearer. FIXTURE uses deterministic inert output and is visibly labeled. REMOTE_ASSISTED fixes the OpenAI Responses endpoint and gpt-6.1-sol; no user-selected model/host/tools.
modes.scope: Initial integration supports complete supported document models and SOURCE_EDIT or EXPLANATION. Unsupported TEXT_ONLY input and partial blocks fail UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE; no raw-source disclosure fallback, private RAG, typed-slot edit claim or automatic Save. Source-edit output may be applied as SOURCE draft, then ordinary Save independently checks it.

anonymization.prepare: Validate the exact candidate through the existing scoped Java worker lane. Require a complete BLOCK_SUPPORTED module. Traverse every declaration/binder name in fixed structural order, replace with globally unique SlotN names, retain the inverse map only in the Spring job, and print a fresh checked module without comments/trivia. Send only this anonymous source and separately reviewed bounded natural-language intent. Do not send document IDs, visual source, comments, names, paths or ownership capabilities in provider input. Intent may contain identifying text; preview explicitly states this.
anonymization.restore: Require generated source to validate to the supported module profile. Its declared names must belong to the prepared slot inventory; reject unknown/duplicate/rebound declaration kinds and incompatible declaration inventories rather than guessing a mapping. Restore names structurally through the local inverse map and reprint without model-supplied trivia. Independently validate the named candidate against the same actual document/base/context. Refuse any failure or stale context. Preserve projection honestly. Generated names/expansion beyond this bounded profile are unsupported.
anonymization.limits: Structural anonymization is not confidentiality or a canonical semantic normal form. No embeddings, retrieval vectors or e-graphs are changed. Source validation does not establish intended behavior. Original draft and comments remain intact until explicit review/apply; review warns that applying the reprinted proposal omits comments, and Undo restores the complete original local draft.

api.config: GET /config returns only enabled mode, model, terms version and nonsecret limits to an authenticated private caller.
api.create: POST /jobs accepts exactly requestId, documentId, baseRevision, draftId, draftEpoch, contentGeneration, artifactId, sourceHash, candidate, intent and kind. UUID requestId is an idempotent create key: identical retry returns the same retained job; conflicting bytes deny. Authoritative current head/artifact/policy/dependency and private launch incarnation are server-derived. Candidate is the exact SOURCE or BLOCK_SUPPORTED draft including existing closed candidate fields. No accepted history mutation.
api.read: GET /jobs/{id} is non-dispatching. A closed job view contains id, status, binding, expiresAt, attempt, payload, payloadHash, model, termsVersion, code and optional proposal. Payload is exact ASCII request bytes presented as an escaped string, never HTML. Proposal contains named source, explanation, projection, sourceHash and proposalHash. Unknown/foreign handles reveal no content.
api.consent: POST /jobs/{id}/disclosure accepts exactly binding, attempt, payloadHash and termsVersion. Check all exact prepared identities and current head/expiry/configuration before unblocking one pending consent. Duplicate approval cannot dispatch again. Every repair returns a new preview and requires fresh explicit consent. No synthetic CLI blanket grant is available in the application.
api.cancel: POST /jobs/{id}/cancel accepts exactly binding; prevents future publication and terminates/drains owned work. Poll cancellation alone is not server cancellation.
api.approve: POST /jobs/{id}/approve accepts exactly binding and proposalHash. Recheck current head/artifact/policy/configuration/expiry; independently revalidate named source using the shared lane. Return one idempotent receipt containing receiptId, jobId, binding, proposalHash, source, sourceHash and expiresAt. Receipt life is at most 10 seconds and no later than job expiry. This authorizes only one local draft edit, never a commit. Replays return the same receipt after current checks without extending expiry.
api.bounds: Canonical existing routing, exact Host/Origin, bearer, no-store/CSP and existing bounded strict JSON apply. Reject query parameters and unknown fields on every AI route; body <=262144 bytes, source <=32768 UTF8 bytes, intent <=4096 UTF8 bytes, bounded IDs and safe integers. Error text is closed codes with no source, credentials, raw provider errors or private paths.

orchestration.ownership: One active private AI job globally, no provider queue; at most three retained bounded jobs. New work while active is BUSY. All prompt/proposal buffers are volatile and expire; restart invalidates them. Every job binds immutable create bytes, document/base/artifact, private launch incarnation, configuration/terms, policy/dependency and exact draft identity. Checks occur before/after provider, verification and approval. Current server head is re-read through existing parser-routed document access.
orchestration.ipc: Run the actual allow_ai.workflow.Runner in a fixed per-job Python subprocess with inherited stdin/stdout pipes and no listener. Frame version, nonce, sequence and closed kind are checked; bounded newline JSON frames <=262144 bytes. Parent owns launch, total deadline, bounded stdout/stderr and reap. Python callbacks exchange AUTH, PREPARED and VERIFY frames; Java answers only the expected frame. Python obtains no SQL or arbitrary host callback capability. Request and credential enter over owned pipes, not argv/env; provider key stays out of graph state, journals and logs. Error bodies remain discarded.
orchestration.consent_and_loop: Runner retains its at-most-two-dispatch authority and deterministic-failure-only repair. A changed repair preview blocks on a new exact disclosure approval. HTTP/auth/rate-limit/unknown/timeout/worker-busy/stale failures terminate without repair. The whole job deadline includes human consent waits and never resets. GET never resumes graph side effects.
orchestration.worker_lane: Production verification never calls synthetic DocumentVerifier. It uses existing DocumentValidationContext, DocumentWorker and WorkerCapacity under current policy/build identity. No SQL transaction, validation context or worker permit is held across provider or consent waits. Worker busy is terminal. Manual document validate/commit/history/analyze/create cancels conflicting active AI work before ordinary admission; cancellation retains ownership until child cleanup. Failed cleanup denies subsequent AI admission.
orchestration.deadline: At most60 seconds from creation for prepare/execution/publication; provider <=20 seconds; worker <=10 seconds and remaining budget. Expired work cannot publish or approve. OS-stalled launch/fsync/mandatory cleanup can exceed a return deadline; ownership stays held until actual cleanup. Do not detach unstoppable threads or claim remote provider cancellation/billing cessation.
orchestration.state: CREATING, AWAITING_DISCLOSURE, GENERATING, VERIFYING, REVIEW_READY, SUGGESTION, APPLIED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, FAILED. Repair goes VERIFYING -> AWAITING_DISCLOSURE with incremented attempt, exact new payload and no invalid proposal publication. Source and explanation are untrusted content until deterministic validation; explanation is always labeled AI suggestion.

accounting_and_credentials.journal: Retain the exclusive content-free durable journal design outside the checkout/installation. The integration journal binds its configured lifetime ceiling immutably in its schema; unknown schema, altered ceiling, missing existing state, insecure paths, concurrent ownership and fsync ambiguity fail closed. No HTTP operation can reset a journal or choose another path. Reserve50000 micro-USD before each dispatch and never auto-refund, including uncertain requests. At most two calls per job. One private installation is one principal, so its hard ceiling is also the principal ceiling. Configurable lifetime ceiling defaults100000 and may be at most10000000 micro-USD; an operator changes it only by a separately reviewed reconciliation/migration, not deleting a ledger or restarting. No daily reset is claimed. No SQL is introduced by this journal.
accounting_and_credentials.tariff: Keep the tested conservative published standard-tier assumptions and token/byte caps. REMOTE startup requires a declared reviewed terms/tariff version and no unknown surcharge. Source/configuration does not claim account billing is proved. FIXTURE has no provider spending and uses a distinct explicitly non-billed ledger.
accounting_and_credentials.key: Operator supplies a non-echo startup key via inherited descriptor/pipe or a protected credential file outside project/installation (owner-only regular file, no linked path, bounded bytes, correct owner). Never persist the supplied chat key anywhere. No key in JVM/Python argv/environment, config, manifest, frontend, source, journal, exception, trace or checkpoint. Disable core dumps for credential-bearing launch. Validator children inherit neither credential nor its descriptor. Distro docs describe operator provisioning without generating or copying a secret.

frontend.flow: Assistant panel inside existing workbench uses exact current candidate, not potentially stale displayed Alloy preview. Show feature/intent, prepare, exact payload/provider/terms and disclosure warning, explicit Send, bounded polling0.5..5seconds, Cancel, before/after source review, validation projection and explicit Apply to draft. EXPLANATION has no Apply button. Render all remote text inertly. Unsupported profile is visible and leaves draft unchanged.
frontend.binding: Token/session online state, accepted document/base/artifact/source/policy/dependency, draftId, epoch, contentGeneration and exact candidate are captured. Any observed change/pending durable save/navigation/session end invalidates the job/receipt and stops polling; request server cancellation. Immediately before applying, re-read current mutable controller snapshot and compare complete binding plus receipt identity/hash/expiry. Consumed receipt cannot apply twice.
frontend.undo: Apply publishes one immutable SOURCE draft transition and stores the complete prior DocumentState locally. Dedicated Undo AI edit restores prior content/mode/copies/constraints with a new epoch/contentGeneration and cleared stale validation, once only and only without intervening content/navigation/save. It never rewinds durable history. Accepted document remains unchanged until ordinary explicit Save.
frontend.distributed_limit: A receipt already delivered may permit a bounded local edit after an unobserved remote revocation. Known invalidation denies local apply; all subsequent server actions and Save recheck authority/head. No stronger instantaneous distributed revocation claim.

distribution_and_structure.package: Extend explicit manifest allowlist with integration Python/Java/frontend build, pinned minimal dependency lock, verified bridge entrypoint, contract/model/evidence and operator instructions. No venv, credentials, journals, private corpus, dumps or ambient runtime included. Default OFF in all generated configs; ANONYMOUS cannot enable private AI. Private opt-in validates executable/dependency/credential/budget configuration before launch. Native target acceptance remains OPEN until actually executed there.
distribution_and_structure.layout: New bridge/lifecycle code belongs under services/ai; keep tested allow_ai library compatibility under retrieval. Add repository and documentation indexes plus reproducible commands. New generated distributions go under ignored artifacts/releases with a small tracked release manifest. Preserve historical gates/closure/spec/formal/dist paths and bytes; do not rewrite history or pretend all large historical blobs were removed. Remove accidental tracking of generated root crash output/node_modules link only after preserving local data. Exclude editor-local settings and runtime secrets from the commit.
distribution_and_structure.git: Use current checkout, create codex/ai-system-integration branch, stage explicit reviewed files only, audit added content for secrets/private data and size, commit then push to existing origin. No force push, history rewrite, unrelated working-tree overwrite or automatic deployment. Prior isolated AI contract/component/evidence are included in the coherent source commit.

formal_first: Six exact-hash adversarial council reviews (2Terra,2Sol,2Astra), then supplement finite Lean4 policy proofs with accepting witnesses and rejection/preservation cases; two clean matching Lean4.34.1 builds before production edits. Model exact-consent, bounded repair, anonymous/private gate, no save, stale receipt/undo identity, accounting and OFF package invariants. Host callbacks, serializers, SQL parser, OS/IPC, clocks, verifier and provider remain trusted; no implementation refinement or quality/commercial proof.
acceptance: New focused Java tests for closed DTO/private OFF/ANONYMOUS denial, anonymization/name restoration, stale/duplicate consent, approval/receipt replay, budget failure and process ownership; existing backend regressions and style cap pass.

Python actual Runner bridge tests including real framed consent/repair/verification, bounded/malformed IPC, wrong nonce/sequence, key-free logs/argv/env/child input and durable ceiling/restart denial; existing50 component tests remain valid or changes are explicitly revalidated.

Frontend tests for exact candidate capture, stale result/receipt denial, one apply/one undo, explicit Save boundary, inert output, cancellation and polling lifecycle; typecheck/build and JSDoc30-line checks pass.

Actual local Spring HTTP and browser acceptance with deterministic provider, exact preview and fresh repair consent, scoped Java verification, Apply/Undo/Save separation and manual operation cancellation. Browser availability failures remain explicitly OPEN, not mocked PASS.

Distribution manifest/extraction/dependency/secret audits, default OFF and anonymous rejection, Linux deployment/config tests and available portable Windows script checks. Do not claim remote IIS/WSL deployment or native acceptance.
